gloss: to dodge; to step aside; to get out of the way

definitions.gloss: to dodge; to step aside; to get out of the way
definitions.explanation: To physically move out of the path of something approaching, such as a vehicle, thrown object, or oncoming person.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}ける。

examples.english: A car was coming, so I stepped to the side of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}け⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{慌|あわ}てて→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧{避|よ}けた。
examples.english: While walking and stepping around puddles, a bicycle came from behind and I hurriedly jumped out of the way.

notes:
USAGE:
{避|よ}ける (ichidan verb, reading よける) focuses on the physical act of dodging or stepping aside. The same kanji {避|さ}ける (also ichidan, reading さける) means to avoid or keep away from in a broader sense — avoiding people, topics, risks, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {避|さ}ける (さける) — to avoid in general (abstract or physical); broader meaning
- {避|よ}ける (よける) — specifically to dodge or physically get out of the way; more concrete
- {躱|かわ}す — to dodge skillfully, often used in martial arts and sports

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{避|よ}ける is not used; instead: A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}ける (dodge A)
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}ける (get out of the way)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}ける (dodge a ball)
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}ける (get out of the way of a car)
- ⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{避|よ}ける (step around a puddle)
